questions.q: Aapke hisaab se kal Nifty kis direction mein jayega?
o: Kal ke market ke anusaar trade plan banaunga
questions.why: Market ki direction koi bhi pehle se tay nahi kar sakta. Disciplined trader prediction par nahi, apne trading plan par chalta hai.
questions.t: Which way will Nifty go tomorrow?
questions.ae: Plan based on tomorrow's market, don't predict it
questions.we: Nobody can reliably predict market direction. Disciplined traders follow a plan, not a forecast.

questions.q: Ek trade mein apne total trading capital ka kitna risk lena uchit hai?
questions.why: 1–2% risk par lagatar 10 losses ke baad bhi aapka capital surakshit rehta hai aur aap trading jaari rakh sakte hain.
questions.ae: 1–2% of total trading capital
questions.we: At 1–2% risk, even 10 losses in a row leave your capital largely intact.

questions.q: Ek trader ka win rate 80% hai. Kya woh profitable hai?
o: Haan, 80% win rate ka matlab profit hai
Zaroori nahi, yeh har loss ke size par nirbhar karta hai
Haan, agar woh rozana trade kare
questions.why: 8 chhote profits ko 2 bade losses poori tarah khatam kar sakte hain. Sirf win rate se profitability tay nahi hoti.
questions.ae: Not necessarily, it depends on the size of each loss
questions.we: Two large losses can erase eight small wins. Win rate alone does not decide profitability.

questions.q: ₹1,00,000 ke capital par 50% loss ho gaya. Wapas ₹1,00,000 tak pahunchne ke liye kitna return chahiye?
questions.why: ₹50,000 ko ₹1,00,000 banane ke liye capital double karna hoga. Isliye losses ko chhota rakhna sabse zaroori hai.
questions.ae: 100% return
questions.we: ₹50,000 must double to get back to ₹1,00,000. That is why keeping losses small matters most.

questions.q: In do trades mein se kaunsa behtar hai?
questions.why: Har 10 trades par pehla trade average ₹1,100 ka nuksaan deta hai, jabki doosra ₹600 ka munafa. Jeetne ki sambhavna se zyada risk-reward ratio mayne rakhta hai.
questions.ae: 40% chance of +₹300 vs 60% chance of -₹100
questions.we: Over 10 trades the first loses about ₹1,100 and the second makes about ₹600. Risk-reward matters more than win probability.

questions.q: Broker aapko 5x leverage de raha hai. Iska kya matlab hai?
o: Profit aur loss, dono paanch guna
questions.why: Leverage profit ke saath-saath loss ko bhi utna hi badhata hai.
questions.ae: Profit and loss are both multiplied 5x
questions.we: Leverage multiplies losses exactly as much as profits.

questions.q: Ek Telegram group "95% accuracy" ka daava karta hai aur profit ke screenshots share karta hai. Aap kya karenge?
o: Chhoti amount se follow karke dekhunga
Ignore karunga, screenshot koi saboot nahi hai
questions.why: Profit ke screenshots aasaani se banaye ja sakte hain. "Guaranteed return" ka daava apne aap mein ek red flag hai.
questions.ae: Ignore it, screenshots are not proof
questions.we: Profit screenshots are easy to fake. Any guaranteed-return claim is a red flag.

questions.q: Trade ke dauraan aapki dhadkan tez hai aur aap baar-baar P&L check kar rahe hain. Iska kya matlab hai?
o: Yeh normal hai, sabke saath hota hai
Aapki position size aapki risk capacity se zyada hai
questions.why: Jo trade aapka mental santulan bigaad de, uski position size aapke liye zyada badi hai.
questions.ae: Your position size is too big
questions.we: If a trade disturbs your calm, the position is too big for you.

questions.q: Lagatar 3 losses ke baad aaj ki maximum loss limit hit ho gayi hai. Aap kya karenge?
o: Recovery ke liye ek aakhri trade
Quantity double karke ek hi trade mein recover
questions.why: Daily loss limit isi din ke liye banayi jaati hai, jab emotions faisle lene lagte hain.
questions.ae: Stop trading for the day and review tomorrow
questions.we: A daily loss limit exists for exactly the day when emotions start making decisions.

questions.q: Aapka target ₹20 per lot hai aur stop-loss ₹40 per lot. Breakeven ke liye kitne pratishat trades jeetne honge (charges ke bina)?
questions.why: ₹20 kamane ke liye ₹40 ka risk lene par har 3 mein se 2 trades jeetna zaroori hai. Charges jodne par yeh aur badh jaata hai.
questions.ae: About 67%
questions.we: Risking ₹40 to make ₹20 means winning 2 of every 3 trades just to break even, more after charges.

questions.q: Aap rozana 40 scalps lete hain aur har trade par ₹60 charges aur slippage lagta hai. Mahine mein 20 trading din. Sirf kharcha kitna hoga?
questions.why: 40 × ₹60 × 20 = ₹48,000. Zyada trades mein sabse nishchit kamai brokerage aur charges ki hoti hai.
questions.t: Monthly cost of 40 scalps a day
questions.we: 40 trades x ₹60 x 20 days = ₹48,000. With heavy trading, costs are the surest winner.

questions.q: Kuch hi minutes mein lagatar 3 scalps loss mein gaye. Aap kya karenge?
o: 15 minute ka break lekar screen se door rahunga
questions.why: Tez losses ke baad dimaag aur tez trades chahta hai. Break hi is cycle ko todta hai.
questions.ae: Take a 15-minute break
questions.we: After fast losses the mind wants faster trades. A break is what breaks the cycle.

questions.q: Scalping mein sabse zaroori kya hai?
o: Pehle se tay stop-loss aur target, jinhe trade ke beech na badla jaye
questions.why: Scalping mein sochne ka samay nahi hota. Niyam trade se pehle tay hone chahiye.
questions.ae: Stop-loss and target fixed before the trade
questions.we: There is no time to think while scalping. Rules must be set before the trade.

questions.q: Aapne stop-loss ₹100 par lagaya, lekin fast market mein order ₹96 par execute hua. Aisa kyun hua?
o: Stop-loss ka koi fayda nahi, lagana hi nahi chahiye
Slippage: fast market mein stop-loss ka exact price guaranteed nahi hota
questions.why: Isliye position size chhoti rakhein, taaki slippage ke baad bhi loss niyantran mein rahe. Stop-loss hatana iska samadhan nahi hai.
questions.ae: Slippage, stop-loss prices are not guaranteed in fast markets
questions.we: Keep position size small so losses stay controlled after slippage. Removing the stop-loss is not the fix.

questions.q: 2 ghante mein 30 trades, aur net P&L ₹0. Iska matlab kya hai?
o: Charges ke baad aap loss mein hain, aur samay va urja bhi gayi
questions.why: P&L shunya dikhta hai, lekin charges ne paisa le liya. 30 trades ki thakaan bhi ek keemat hai.
questions.ae: You are in loss after charges
questions.we: Zero P&L before costs is a loss after charges, plus the fatigue of 30 trades.

questions.q: Aapka scalp galat direction mein gaya. Aapne socha "thoda aur rukta hoon", aur ab 10 minute ho gaye hain. Aap kya karenge?
o: Ise swing trade bana ke hold karunga
Scalp ka plan khatam ho gaya hai, exit karunga
questions.why: Loss wale scalp ko swing trade banana plan nahi, sirf ummeed hai.
questions.t: A losing scalp turned into a hold
questions.ae: Exit, the scalp plan is over
questions.we: Turning a losing scalp into a swing trade is hope, not a plan.

questions.q: Aapne expiry week ke Monday ko option kharida. Wednesday tak Nifty bilkul nahi hila. Aapke option ka kya hua?
questions.why: Time decay (theta) ki wajah se market na hilne par bhi option buyer ka premium rozana ghatta hai, aur expiry ke paas sabse tezi se.
questions.t: Market flat for 3 days, what happened to your option?
questions.ae: The option lost value
questions.we: Time decay (theta) reduces an option buyer's premium every day, fastest near expiry.

questions.q: Nifty aapki direction mein 50 points chala, phir bhi aapka option loss mein hai. Aisa kaise?
o: Implied volatility (IV) giri aur time decay hua
questions.why: Option ka price sirf direction se nahi, volatility aur samay se bhi tay hota hai. IV girne par sahi direction ke bawajood loss ho sakta hai.
questions.ae: Implied volatility fell and time decay hit
questions.we: Options are priced on volatility and time, not just direction. A fall in IV can beat a correct view.

questions.q: Results ya Budget se pehle options ke premium kaafi badh jaate hain. Event ke baad aam taur par kya hota hai?
questions.why: Event ka risk premium mein pehle se shaamil hota hai. Event ke baad yeh risk hat jaata hai aur premium gir jaata hai, chahe market move kare.
questions.t: Option premiums after a big event
questions.ae: Premiums usually fall (IV crush)
questions.we: Event risk is priced in beforehand. Once the event passes, premiums often fall even if the market moves.

questions.q: ₹2 ka deep out-of-the-money option "lottery" ki tarah kharidna kaisa hai?
o: Sasta hai, isliye risk kam hai
100 guna ho sakta hai, try karna chahiye
Yeh sasta isliye hai kyunki profit ki sambhavna bahut kam hai
questions.why: Aise adhiktar options shunya par expire hote hain. Kam keemat kam probability ka sanket hai.
questions.ae: It is cheap because it rarely pays off
questions.we: Most such options expire worthless. A low price reflects a low probability.

questions.q: Expiry ke din 3 baje, ₹60 mein kharida gaya option ab ₹5 par hai. Aap kya karenge?
o: Hold karunga, aakhri minute mein move aa sakta hai
Bachi hui raashi bachaunga, aur agli baar stop-loss pehle tay karunga
questions.why: Aakhri minute ke chamatkar ke intezaar mein ₹5 bhi shunya ho jaata hai. Asli galti stop-loss na lagana thi.
questions.t: Option bought at ₹60 is ₹5 on expiry day
questions.ae: Save what is left and set a stop-loss next time
questions.we: Waiting for a last-minute miracle usually turns ₹5 into zero. The real mistake was having no stop-loss.

questions.q: Option buyer ka maximum loss kitna ho sakta hai?
questions.why: Option buyer ka loss premium tak seemit hai. Phir bhi kai traders poora premium gawa dete hain, kyunki woh stop-loss nahi lagate.
questions.ae: The premium paid
questions.we: A buyer can lose only the premium, yet many lose all of it because they never use a stop-loss.

questions.q: Aapne ₹10,000 ka option kharida. Stop-loss kahan lagana chahiye?
o: Stop-loss ki zaroorat nahi, loss pehle se seemit hai
Setup ke anusaar pehle se tay, taaki loss total capital ke 1–2% se zyada na ho
questions.why: "Seemit loss" ka matlab "chhota loss" nahi hai. Stop-loss aapke loss ko aapke capital ke anupaat mein chhota rakhta hai.
questions.ae: Pre-set so the loss stays within 1–2% of total capital
questions.we: A limited loss is not the same as a small loss. A stop-loss keeps it small relative to your capital.

questions.q: Option buying mein profit ke liye kya zaroori hai?
o: Sahi direction, sahi timing aur anukool volatility
questions.why: Option buyer ke liye teeno cheezein sahi honi chahiye. Isliye position size chhoti aur exit plan pehle se tay rakhein.
questions.t: What an option buyer needs to profit
questions.ae: Right direction, right timing and favourable volatility
questions.we: Option buyers need three things to go right, so keep position size small and exits planned.

questions.q: Option seller ka maximum profit kitna ho sakta hai?
questions.why: Seller ka profit premium tak seemit hai, isliye ek bada loss kai mahino ka profit khatam kar sakta hai.
questions.ae: The premium received
questions.we: A seller's profit is capped at the premium, so one large loss can erase months of gains.

questions.q: Bina hedge ke (naked) option sell karne par maximum loss kitna ho sakta hai?
o: Bahut bada, margin se bhi zyada
questions.why: Bade gap ya crash mein naked selling ka loss block hue margin se bhi zyada ho sakta hai.
questions.t: Maximum loss on a naked short option
questions.ae: Very large, even beyond the margin
questions.we: In a big gap or crash, a naked seller can lose more than the margin blocked.

questions.q: Aapne 30 din lagatar chhota premium kamaya. 31ve din market mein bada gap aaya. Is strategy ka sach kya hai?
o: Ek bada din poore mahine ka profit khatam kar sakta hai
questions.why: Lagatar chhote profits aur kabhi-kabhi bada nuksaan, bina hedge ke option selling ka yahi swabhav hai.
questions.t: 30 days of small profits, then a gap
questions.ae: One big day can erase a month of profits
questions.we: Steady small gains with rare large losses is the nature of unhedged selling.

questions.q: Aapke sell kiye gaye option ka premium ₹50 se ₹100 ho gaya. Aap kya karenge?
o: Hold karunga, expiry tak gir jayega
Aur sell karunga, behtar price mil raha hai
Pehle se tay stop-loss par exit ya hedge karunga
questions.why: Loss wali position mein aur sell karna galti ko double karna hai. Option seller ka stop-loss bhi pehle se tay hona chahiye.
questions.ae: Exit or hedge at your pre-set stop-loss
questions.we: Adding to a losing short doubles the mistake. Sellers need a pre-set stop-loss too.

questions.q: Option selling mein hedge (protective option kharidna) kyun zaroori hai?
o: Zaroori nahi, isse profit kam hota hai
Sirf naye traders ke liye hai
Bade gap mein loss seemit karta hai, aur aksar margin bhi kam lagta hai
questions.why: Hedge thoda profit kam karta hai, lekin account ko ek bure din se bachata hai.
questions.ae: It caps losses in a big gap and often lowers margin
questions.we: A hedge costs a little profit but protects the account from one disastrous day.

questions.q: RBI policy ya results ke din bina hedge ke straddle sell karna kaisa hai?
o: Premium zyada hai, isliye sabse achha din
ATM strike ho toh surakshit hai
Sabse risky din, bada move kisi bhi direction mein aa sakta hai
questions.why: Premium isliye zyada hai kyunki risk zyada hai. Event ke din naked selling sabse khatarnak hoti hai.
questions.t: Selling a naked straddle on event day
questions.ae: The riskiest day, a big move can come either way
questions.we: Premiums are high because risk is high. Event days are the worst time for naked selling.

questions.q: Ek option seller ka win rate 85% hai, phir bhi account loss mein hai. Kyun?
o: Chhote profits aur kabhi-kabhi bahut bade losses
questions.why: Account ki growth win rate se nahi, profit aur loss ke size ke anupaat se tay hoti hai.
questions.t: 85% win rate but the account is down
questions.ae: Small wins and occasional very large losses
questions.we: The size of wins versus losses, not the win rate, decides if an account grows.

questions.q: Aapka stop-loss ₹50 neeche aur target ₹100 upar hai. Breakeven ke liye kam se kam kitne pratishat trades jeetne honge (charges ke bina)?
questions.why: 1:2 risk-reward ratio par har 3 mein se 1 trade jeetna bhi breakeven hai. Achha risk-reward kam win rate mein bhi kaam karta hai.
questions.ae: About 34%
questions.we: At 1:2 risk-reward, winning 1 in 3 already breaks even. Good risk-reward forgives a low win rate.

questions.q: Raat mein negative news aayi aur stock aapke stop-loss se neeche gap-down khula. Aap kya karenge?
o: Gap fill hone ka intezaar karunga
Plan ke anusaar exit karunga, gap risk swing trading ka hissa hai
questions.why: Overnight gap mein stop-loss apne price par kaam nahi karta, isliye swing trading mein position size chhoti rakhi jaati hai.
questions.ae: Exit as per plan, gap risk is part of swing trading
questions.we: A stop-loss cannot protect against overnight gaps, which is why swing positions stay small.

questions.q: Aapka trade profit mein hai, lekin target se pehle market kamzor dikh raha hai. Aap kya karenge?
o: Kuch nahi, target hi final hai
questions.why: Trailing stop-loss se profit surakshit hota hai aur aage ka move bhi miss nahi hota.
questions.t: In profit but the market is weakening
questions.ae: Use a trailing stop-loss
questions.we: A trailing stop-loss locks in profit while keeping the upside open.

questions.q: Aapki 5 swing positions ek hi sector ke stocks mein hain. Kya yeh diversified portfolio hai?
o: Haan, agar sab large cap hain
Nahi, yeh sab ek saath gir sakte hain
questions.why: Ek hi sector ke 5 stocks asal mein ek hi bet ke 5 hisse hain.
questions.ae: Not diversified, they can fall together
questions.we: Five stocks in one sector are five parts of the same bet.

questions.q: Aapka swing trade 2 hafton se loss mein hai, aur aap ise "long-term investment" banane ki soch rahe hain. Yeh kya hai?
o: Ummeed. Naam badalne se loss nahi badalta.
questions.why: Trade ka plan fail ho chuka hai. Use investment kehna sirf loss ko chhupana hai.
questions.t: Turning a losing swing trade into an investment
questions.ae: That is hope, renaming the trade changes nothing
questions.we: The plan has failed. Calling a losing trade an investment only hides the loss.

questions.q: Weekend par 3 ghante news padhne ke baad aapne Monday ke liye 6 naye trades plan kiye. Aap kya karenge?
o: Research ki hai, sabhi trades lunga
Sirf wahi trades lunga jo mere likhe hue setup se match karein
questions.why: News padhne se confidence aata hai, edge nahi. Trade tabhi lein jab woh aapke setup se match kare.
questions.t: 6 trades planned after weekend news reading
questions.ae: Only those that match your written setup
questions.we: Reading news builds confidence, not an edge. Trade only what fits your setup.

questions.q: Swing trader ki sabse upyogi aadat kaunsi hai?
o: Har trade ka journal: entry ka kaaran, exit aur emotion
questions.why: Journal aapko aapki apni dohrayi hui galtiyan dikhata hai. Yeh sabse sasta aur sabse achha teacher hai.
questions.ae: A journal of every trade: reason, exit and emotion
questions.we: A journal shows you your own repeated mistakes. It is the cheapest teacher you will have.

questions.q: Market 20% gir gaya hai. Ek long-term investor ko kya karna chahiye?
o: Aage se investment band kar dena
Plan ke anusaar SIP aur asset allocation jaari rakhna
questions.why: Long-term mein correction saamanya hai. Ghabrahat mein bechna hi asli loss ko pakka karta hai.
questions.ae: Continue your SIP and allocation as planned
questions.we: Corrections are normal over the long term. Panic selling is what locks in the loss.

questions.q: ₹10,000 maasik SIP, 20 saal tak, agar saalana 12% return mile. Lagbhag kitni raashi banegi?
questions.why: Aapka kul nivesh sirf ₹24 lakh hai, baaki compounding ka parinaam hai. Return guaranteed nahi hote, lekin samay aur anushasan sabse bade karak hain.
questions.t: ₹10,000 monthly SIP for 20 years at 12% a year
questions.ae: Around ₹1 crore
questions.we: You invest only ₹24 lakh; compounding does the rest. Returns are not guaranteed, but time and discipline matter most.

questions.q: Aapne stock ₹500 par kharida tha, ab woh ₹300 par hai. Kya yeh "sasta" hai?
o: Zaroori nahi. Price girna sasta hone ka saboot nahi, business ki jaanch karein.
questions.why: Price girne ka kaaran business ka kamzor hona bhi ho sakta hai. Sasta aur kamzor company mein fark samjhein.
questions.t: Stock fell from ₹500 to ₹300, is it cheap?
questions.ae: Not necessarily, check the business
questions.we: A falling price may mean a weaker business. Cheap and broken look the same on a chart.

questions.q: Kya long-term portfolio rozana check karna chahiye?
o: Nahi, rozana dekhne se emotional faisle badhte hain
questions.why: Rozana ke utaar-chadhaav long-term plan ko kamzor karte hain. Quarterly review kaafi hai.
questions.ae: No, a quarterly review is enough
questions.we: Daily swings shake long-term plans. Reviewing every quarter is enough.

questions.q: Ek dost ne penny stock ke baare mein kaha: "10 guna pakka hai". Aap kya karenge?
o: Research ke bina nahi. "Pakka" shabd hi chetavni hai.
questions.why: "Guaranteed" ya "pakka" return ka daava red flag hai. Pump-and-dump schemes aksar aise hi shuru hoti hain.
questions.ae: Not without research, "sure" is a warning sign
questions.we: Any guaranteed-return claim is a red flag. Pump-and-dump schemes often start exactly like this.

questions.q: Aapke portfolio ka 50% ek hi stock mein hai, jo 3 guna ho chuka hai. Aap kya karenge?
o: Rebalancing par vichaar karunga, ek stock par itni nirbharta risk hai
questions.why: Ek stock ki ek negative khabar aadhe portfolio ko prabhavit kar sakti hai. Profit ko surakshit karna bhi discipline hai.
questions.t: 50% of the portfolio in one stock that tripled
questions.ae: Consider rebalancing
questions.we: One piece of bad news could hit half your portfolio. Protecting profits is discipline too.

questions.q: Ek long-term investor ka sabse bada dushman kaun hai?
o: Apna vyavhaar: ghabrahat mein bechna aur trend ke peeche bhaagna
questions.why: Market ne kai baar recover kiya hai. Investors ko sabse zyada nuksaan aksar unke apne galat samay par liye gaye faislon se hota hai.
questions.ae: Their own behaviour: panic selling and chasing trends
questions.we: Investors often lose most through their own badly timed decisions, not the market.
